|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ハンを失うと考えただけで、チューバッカの心は引き裂かれそうになった。その雄叫びは悲痛に満ちていた。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Mournful Roar.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on Chewie just after Han is lost or goes missing. The opponent cannot use Let The Wookiee Win or Wookiee Roar. The opponent also loses 1 Force at the end of each player’s turn. Cancel this Effect if Han is deployed again or found.

'''Lore:'''
The thought of losing Han nearly tore Chewbacca’s heart apart. His roar was full of anguish.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says the thought of losing Han nearly tore Chewbacca’s heart apart.
